scripts.build: npm run build -w @jff/shared && npm run build -w @jff/host && npm run build -w @jff/extension
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b shared host extension && tsc -p e2e && tsc -p extension/tsconfig.node.json
scripts.smoke: JFF_TEST_SEAM=1 npm run build && playwright test
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run smoke
scripts.readme:shots: JFF_TEST_SEAM=1 npm run build && playwright test --config docs/readme/playwright.config.ts; s=$?; npm run build && exit $s
